It also forbids a route the environment allows: 'The key may be picked up first. It must then be dropped to pick up the ball, and that drop fires key_lost while the door is closed.' As written, the natural finish (set the ball aside, take the key, open the door, take the box) fails, and the machine reaches its final state only when the ball is back in front of the door at box pickup, which the task never asks for. Keep the hard Existence(target_picked_up), which is correct.
